aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image. If not specified, it is determined automatically from the input image.

images.description: List of URLs of input images for editing.

mask_image.description: Optional mask for the first input image: white marks the area to edit, black the area to keep (a PNG where transparent marks the area to edit is also accepted). It is resized to the first image.

output_format.description: The format of the output image.

prompt.description: The positive prompt for the generation.

quality.description: Rendering quality tier. Higher tiers add detail and cost more: low is the fastest draft tier, medium is the balanced default, high and xhigh add fidelity, max is the highest-fidelity tier.

resolution.description: The resolution of the output image.
